item.title: Cookie Policy
item.description:
Last Updated: November 9, 2026

This Cookie Policy explains how CSRGO (“we”, “us”, or “our”) uses cookies and similar client-side technologies when you visit our website at https://csrgo.com and its associated subdomains across the CSRGO digital ecosystem (including tools.csrgo.com, dsa.csrgo.com, and blog.csrgo.com) (collectively, the “Site”).

It describes what these technologies are, why we use them, and the choices you have to manage or disable them.

1. What Are Cookies and Web Storage?

  • Cookies: Cookies are small text files placed on your computer, smartphone, or tablet when you visit a website. They are widely used by website operators to make websites function efficiently, retain session states, and provide analytical reporting.
  • Local Storage: HTML5 Local Storage (localStorage) allows web applications to store data locally within the user’s browser without transferring that data across network requests. Data stored in localStorage persists until cleared by the user or web application.

2. Our Approach: No First-Party Tracking Cookies

Because CSRGO is built around a philosophy of zero friction and client-side privacy, we do not operate login accounts, member profiles, or user dashboards:

item.title: About CSRGO
item.description:
One Door to All Different Tools

CSRGO was built with a clear purpose: to serve as a unified gateway and single launchpad to a fast-growing, evolving ecosystem of purpose-built micro-platforms. Instead of fragmented bookmarks and account barriers, CSRGO provides instant, zero-login access to specialized web utilities, coding problem archives, technical insights, celebratory experiences, and digital engineering services.

Our Mission

Our mission is to eliminate digital friction. We believe essential developer utilities, algorithm training, and high-value tools should be immediately accessible, lightning-fast, and free from mandatory account creation or clutter.
